title: THE DAYS YOU ARE ALLOWED TO BURN
concept: Alaska has mapped the days you must not burn in exhaustive detail and has never mapped the days you can. NSF paid UAF $1,588,147 on July 31 to have machine learning read decades of weather and find them. The film draws prohibition as an edgeless flood and permission as a hard-edged cut window, so a muted viewer can tell them apart by silhouette alone.

angle.thesis: Alaska has spent decades mapping the days you must not burn, and nobody has mapped the days you can, so NSF paid UAF $1,588,147 to have machine learning read decades of weather and find them.
angle.valence_defense: All three analysts landed here independently. The claim is about a funding decision, which is complete, dated and verified, not about acres burned. NSF looked at Alaska's fire problem on 2026-07-31, agreed the binding constraint is that nobody can tell an Alaskan which days are safe to burn, and paid to fix exactly that. Reaching for mixed would mean manufacturing a downside, which config/brand.yaml bans. Celebratory WITH THE CLOCK SHOWN is the honest register.
supporting_facts: THE VERB INVERSION, and it is the funder's framing not ours. Almost every wildfire-and-AI story is about detecting or fighting fire. This award is about identifying 'windows of conditions favorable for safe prescribed burning'. It is a permission calendar, not a detection system.

IT IS A PORT, NOT A MOONSHOT. The Prescribed Fire and Smoke Planner already runs across the contiguous United States. The Alaska job is rebuilding it on the Canadian Forest Fire Weather Index system 'on which Alaska's fire management relies'. The Lower 48 tool does not fail here because Alaska is cold, it fails because Alaska runs a different index than the tool speaks.
NSF'S OWN AWARD RECORD carries an 'Artificial Intelligence (AI)' program element alongside 'FIRE-Wildland Fire', so the AI framing belongs to the funder.
THE MONEY BUYS SOMETHING THAT OUTLIVES IT: a curriculum for a new four-year wildland fire management program at UAF. Money leaves and models age, a degree program stays.
angle.fair_counterpoint_it_must_honor: The forecast is not the whole chain, and the film says so on screen. Nothing reaches a burn boss until the award ends on 2030-08-31. A perfect burn-window calendar still does not clear a burn plan, settle a smoke complaint, staff a crew, or get a neighbour's consent. And liability for an escaped prescribed fire, which practitioners name as the real blocker, appears nowhere in this award. The honest version is that the forecast is the upstream input every other link depends on, not that it finishes the job.

runners_up.thesis: NSF refused to buy only the tool, splitting the award across the forecast, the consent layer and a degree, which is money aimed at the whole chain instead of the legible link.
runners_up.why_it_lost: It is a meta-argument about grant design rather than about Alaska, and a muted viewer cannot see 'well-shaped award'. GRAFTED: its fourth box, outlined and empty and labeled LIABILITY with no arrow into it, becomes the film's fair counter-point image.

runners_up.thesis: The machine learning matters less as a fire tool than as a consent tool, converting a burn boss's private judgment into a shared calendar four institutions can argue over from the same page.
runners_up.why_it_lost: It is the most sophisticated read in the room and it needs a beat of setup the hook cannot afford. GRAFTED WHOLESALE AS ACT 2: the sheet slides sideways and three more pairs of hands come into frame around it. One person guessing becomes four people reading.

cuts_the_room_agreed_on: THE TOK BURN PERMIT SUSPENSION. Caught by the enthusiast and it is a real category error, not a taste call. A suspended burn permit governs a private landowner's debris pile. A prescribed fire is an agency operation with a burn boss and a written prescription. Different activities, different authorities. Stacking them into one ironic beat would tell a knowledgeable Alaskan in one second that the film does not know the difference. CUT, although it was the orchestrator's own favourite hook.

THE 52 PERCENT HUMAN-CAUSED FIGURE. All three analysts cut it independently. Human-caused there means ACCIDENTAL ignition, and this award is about DELIBERATE ignition. Putting them together invites a viewer to fuse 'people start too many fires' with 'this project has people start fires', which argues against the piece by accident.
THE FOUR CO-PI NAMES. Waigl as PI is enough attribution for ninety seconds. A roster read-out is credits, not story.
angle.story_question: Which days is an Alaskan actually allowed to light a fire on purpose, and why has nobody counted them?

treatment.winner: THE ENTHUSIAST, drawn honestly with the clock shown
treatment.judge_reasoning: All three analysts independently returned celebratory, so the room did not need a tiebreak on valence, it needed the best DRAWING of it. The enthusiast supplied the inverted map, which states the entire thesis in one silent shot and loops back to frame one. The systems analyst's outlined empty LIABILITY box was grafted in as the fair counter-point at 72.6s, because it draws the film's own limit instead of narrating it. The practitioner's four-hands-around-one-sheet was grafted wholesale as Act 2, because it answers what a count is actually FOR. The comedian lens was not convened, deliberately: this story has no villain and a personified-object gag aimed at a village's land authorities would be exactly the cheap shot the brand bans.
grafts: inverted map (enthusiast) as the signature shot and button
empty LIABILITY box (systems analyst) as the fair counter-point
four hands on one sheet (practitioner) as the whole of Act 2

fingerprint.palette: sun-blocked amber haze #e8c9a4 over tan duff #6b4a3a and near-black boreal spruce #1f3833, ember orange #e2571f as the prohibition, chalk enamel #e6e2d6 and oxidized steel #7d8f92 for every instrument, and a single cool spring green #3fbf7f spent only on a day you are allowed to burn
fingerprint.metaphor: a prohibition drawn as a flood with no edge, and a permission drawn as a window punched clean through it, so the thing nobody counted is the only object in the film with a border

palette: sun-blocked amber haze, tan duff, near-black spruce, ember orange prohibition, chalk enamel and oxidized steel instruments, a single cool green permission
binding_palette_rule: #3fbf7f MEANS A DAY YOU MAY BURN AND NOTHING ELSE. It is first licensed at the PUNCH (41.90s), where the window's interior carries it while the hard beam it throws stays bone #f2e8d8, so the accent lives on the aperture and the light stays uncoloured. Shots 1 to 4 license NOTHING, because no safe day has been asserted yet. Enforced at paint time by the AccentRegistry, using this run's craft advance useAccentExtent, because every licensed green here is a window with a real width and height and a point check would license one by its centre while its edges spilled outside. NO chalk-enamel APPEARS ANYWHERE IN THIS FILM.
divergence_note: The last two dispatches were 2026-07-31, a cool pale-blue sky over tan gravel with a citron accent and a rules-kit hero, and 2026-08-02, a near-black interior bench room lit by one hard chalk-enamel practical with a rhyolite magenta accent and a sample-reading hero. This film is neither. It is a HIGH-KEY WARM EXTERIOR in amber smoke with no cool sky anywhere in it, its light plan is deliberately the inverse of 08-02 (smoke kills shadow, so there is almost no key, very high fill, and low contrast, with exactly one hard-edged beam in the whole film), and its accent is pushed to a COOL BLUE-GREEN specifically so it does not rhyme with 07-31's yellow-green citron. The hero is net-new and fills a real gap: every instrument on the shelf reads a PLACE or a THING and nothing on it reads TIME. The dominant move is a VERTICAL PUNCH against 08-02's horizontal traverse. PALETTE CORRECTION made at Gate 0A: the first draft reached for warm chalk-enamel instruments, which the divergence check caught as a repeat of the 08-02 world's chalk-enamel-plus-one-accent structure. chalk-enamel is gone from this film entirely. The instruments are CHALK ENAMEL and OXIDIZED STEEL, a cool dry pairing that reads as field equipment rather than bench hardware and sits deliberately against the warm haze instead of joining it.
cultural_note: The film names the four governing entities in the NSF abstract's own words, MUNICIPAL / FEDERAL / TRIBAL / NON-PROFIT, as neutral chalk-enamel plates of equal size and weight. No Alaska Native organization is characterized, given a face, or made the subject of a gag, and no Native iconography or Native-language word appears. The four-hands beat deliberately shows four equal parties around one document, never a hierarchy and never a holdout.

open_loop.what: A blank date plate swings in on the stamp stroke at 15.26s and stays EMPTY. The film never mentions it again for 74.4 seconds. At 89.62s the windows open and the plate finally carries a date, and the date is 2030, which is the honest answer rather than the flattering one.

reveals.what: the camera pulls back off one punched window until the whole season stands in frame, nearly solid, so the count is felt as a size rather than read as a number
three arrows drive into three boxes and fill them while a fourth stays a wide dashed void
the wash drains off the Alaska map and the same landmass re-lights as hard-edged windows, the prohibition map inverted into a permission map

audio_arc.note: exactly ONE riser in the piece, at the drain. The 44s pullback was demoted to a run of hole-ticks after Gate 0C counted two risers.

draw.action: three fat arrows DRIVE into three boxes and fill them, and the fourth stays a wide dashed void with nothing entering it
draw.annotation: LIABILITY, who pays when a burn escapes

beats.means: the fair counter-point as an absence. The sound is on the three that actually strike

choreo.primary: three arrows drive in and the boxes fill
choreo.reaction: the fourth box's dashed contour flickers once and holds
choreo.ambient: haze drifting THROUGH the void interior

beats.title: THE ARROW DISASSEMBLES
beats.vo: And who pays when a burn escapes isn't in this award.

draw.subject: the empty fourth box
draw.action: a fourth arrow head ENTERS, reaches the dashed contour, and comes APART into pieces that fall away
draw.annotation: not in this award

beats.means: a new motion rather than a repeat, and the film's one planned rest

choreo.primary: the arrow reaches the contour and disassembles
choreo.reaction: the pieces drop out of frame
choreo.ambient: haze drifting through the void

beats.title: THE TORCH SWINGS DOWN
beats.vo: But nothing moves without that count. You can't staff a crew for a day nobody calls safe.

draw.subject: a fire crew at the edge of the spruce, torch unlit
draw.action: the crew boss's arm DROPS and the unlit torch swings down and knocks against a boot
draw.annotation: a crew with no day to go on

beats.means: the argument made physical and human, now under the line that argues it

choreo.primary: the arm drops and the torch knocks the boot
choreo.reaction: the other two shift their weight
choreo.ambient: smoke sheeting past at knee height

beats.title: THE BLANK SHEET LOWERS
beats.vo: But nothing moves without that count. You can't staff a crew for a day nobody calls safe.

draw.subject: the day sheet in the crew boss's hand
draw.action: the sheet comes up, shows NO punched window, and LOWERS out of the light
draw.annotation: no day called safe

beats.means: you can't staff a crew for a day nobody calls safe, drawn

choreo.primary: the sheet lifts, holds blank, and lowers
choreo.reaction: the boss's shoulders drop a little
choreo.ambient: haze closing over the crew

beats.title: THE WASH DRAINS OFF
beats.vo: Alaska knows exactly which days it's in danger.

draw.subject: the Alaska map from frame one
draw.action: the ember wash TEARS loose from the coastline and RUNS off the bottom of frame in sheets
draw.annotation: DAYS IN DANGER, mapped for decades

beats.means: the loopback. The drain reveals that the wash WAS a perfect danger map, which is exactly what this line says

choreo.primary: the wash tears loose and runs off the bottom
choreo.reaction: the coastline reappears behind it
choreo.ambient: trailing edges whipping as they go

beats.title: THE WINDOWS OPEN
beats.vo: Somebody is finally paid to count the days it's allowed.

draw.subject: the bare map
draw.action: hard-edged windows SNAP open across the Interior one after another, dashed at first, then HARDENING to solid bevelled apertures
draw.annotation: the days you are allowed, still to be counted

beats.means: REVEAL 2 and the signature shot, on the button line where it belongs. Drawn as dashed-then-hardening so the film never claims a count that does not exist yet

choreo.primary: windows snap open and harden across the map
choreo.reaction: the dead ZERO counter finally lights, showing a dash not a number
choreo.ambient: haze thinning off the plate

beats.title: THE PULASKI FLIPS
beats.vo: Somebody is finally paid to count the days it's allowed.

draw.subject: the corner icon planted since frame one
draw.action: the pulaski FLIPS on its hinge and LANDS as a drip torch, and nothing else in frame moves
draw.annotation: somebody is finally paid to count

beats.means: the button. One icon carries the whole thesis change, and it has been on screen for ninety seconds

choreo.primary: the icon flips on its hinge and lands
choreo.reaction: the hinge pin catches the light once
choreo.ambient: the windows holding steady behind it

shape_language_note: THREE grammars, not two, declared after Gate 0D caught the collision. FLOOD is prohibition and has no edge. APERTURE is permission, hard-edged, bevelled, and always PORTRAIT. DASHED-UNFILLED is a stated absence (the 2026-07-30 RingedSealGhost precedent) and is always WIDE LANDSCAPE with NO bevel and visible haze drifting through its interior, so the liability void can never be mistaken for a burn window in silhouette.
